Microsoft Copilot is expanding AI model options with GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra, rolling out across Cowork, Copilot Studio, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Chat. Astra requires enabling the OpenAI subprocessor. Users with appropriate licenses and configurations get default access; no action is needed but reviewing settings and guidance is recommended.
